entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6165699748417797504: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 65109: distance 18.021 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.003), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 18.021 +/- 0.054 pc; Gaia DR3 gives this source no parallax (a two-parameter solution). Proper motion: Gaia DR3 source 6165699748417797504 is a two-parameter solution with no proper motion; zero is assumed (at 18 pc, 1 mas/yr would be 0 km/s across the sky). Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 6165699748417797504 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.872 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 65109: radius 1.872 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 22.456 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.088) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 9191 +/- 421 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 65109: effective temperature 9191 +/- 421 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.034).
